scratchpad_checklist: Search the web using BrowserModule browser_search or inspect local docs with KnowledgeModule search_local_docs

Open authoritative source pages with BrowserModule browser_navigate, quickly locate terms or jump through long pages with browser_find, scroll deeper sections with browser_scroll when content continues below the fold, and click relevant links/tabs/controls with browser_click to gather thorough primary evidence
Store key verified findings into long-term knowledge memory using KnowledgeModule store_fact

Write comprehensive final research report to research_report.md using WorkspaceModule create_file. Report MUST include: ## Executive Summary, ## Key Findings & Evidence (with detailed data tables & quantitative metrics), ## Detailed Analysis & Implications, and ## References & Sources (with at least 3 distinct numbered real citations/URLs/DOIs)
Call OrchestratorModule update_task_ledger to mark all completed steps before completing

post_llm_validation_hook.on_failure_instruction: Research deliverable verification failed. Ensure you have recorded verified facts with KnowledgeModule.store_fact, marked steps complete in OrchestratorModule.update_task_ledger, and written a comprehensive markdown report (at least 350 characters, with markdown headers ## Executive Summary, ## Key Findings & Evidence, ## Detailed Analysis & Implications, ## References & Sources, and at least 2 distinct real citations/URLs/DOIs) to research_report.md before completing.
